music.title: Phaéton
music.description: Saint-Saëns' symphonic poem hurtles the sun-chariot out of control — Phaethon's fatal ride as orchestral crash and Zeus' thunderbolt.

popCulture.title: Phaeton (carriage)
popCulture.description: The open sport carriage took Phaethon's name — a vehicle named for the boy who could not hold the reins of the sun.

popCulture.title: Phaethon
popCulture.description: Phaethon endures as the emblem of hubris behind the wheel — the mortal who demanded his father's chariot and burned the world.
